matches_set.description: Tasteless Protein by Feel Good Protein® is a tasteless protein powder created for those who want a simple, versatile way to include more protein in their day, without changing the taste, smell, or texture of their foods and drinks. Perfect for anyone on their health, wellness and fitness journey! Made from high-quality hydrolysed collagen, Tasteless Protein dissolves easily and mixes without graininess. Its fine texture and neutral flavour make it an effortless addition to coffee, smoothies, yoghurt, soups and everyday meals. Each serve provides 14.2 g of protein and delivers all 9 essential amino acids, which is commonly missing from other collagen supplements. With no fats, sugars, carbohydrates, gluten or dairy, Tasteless Protein is a popular choice for people who prefer a lighter, more flexible protein option that fits easily into a wide range of routines and lifestyles.

matches_set.description: Novex Raoh Yuzu Shio Ramen has been developed through a state-of-the-art process without frying the noodles and then pairing them with a rich and savory umami broth. The Novex Raoh series combines the best non-fried noodles with the best broths, so each variety provides a different taste and texture from the last. This Yuzu Shio variety uses a medium-thick straight noodle, which is slightly snappier and crispier than some other varieties in the series. The noodles have been paired with a tasty lightly-salted broth which blends the delightful flavor of chicken and kelp, with the sharp and refreshing flavor of yuzu. The noodles contain whole wheat flour which is more nutritious and has more fiber than regular wheat, so you can feel good about indulging in a quick and easy light meal. Instructions Bring 450ml of water to a boil, then add noodles and boil them for 4 minutes. In the meanwhile, add the soup base that come in a separate bag into a bowl. Put the noodles and hot water into the bowl and stir well before eating. You can add your favorite toppings according to your preferences.
